annotations.note: Named for the Pequot people of Connecticut, all but destroyed in the war of 1637. Melville names the ship after an exterminated nation.
Nantucket whaling was run by Quaker families. Their plain speech and formal pacifism sat against the most violent trade at sea, a contradiction the novel works throughout.
Ship's biscuit, or hardtack: flour and water baked twice to drive out all moisture so it would keep for years. Proverbially hard.

annotations.anchor: those fast days for which his state is famous
annotations.note: New England states proclaimed official days of public fasting and humiliation into the 19th century. Massachusetts kept an annual Fast Day until 1894.
The marine chronometer a ship's navigation depended on. Patent marks a proprietary improved movement, sold on its reliability in any climate.
A wife from Cape Cod. Whaling families were concentrated there and on Nantucket, and wives were left ashore for voyages of three or four years.
In this period the fishery means the whaling industry, not fishing. Melville uses it throughout for the trade as a whole.
To lower is to drop the whaleboats from the davits and give chase. Lowering after dark was avoided because a struck whale could tow a boat out of sight of the ship.
Dark-complexioned, swarthy. Archaic by Melville's time and used here for its bluntness.
John Bunyan wrote The Pilgrim's Progress during twelve years in Bedford gaol for preaching without a licence. The convict and the pearl are the same fact.
Cervantes lost the use of his left hand to gunshot at Lepanto and died poor. The stumped and paupered arm is literal before it is figurative.
Jackson was born to poor Scots-Irish settlers in the Carolina backcountry and reached the presidency. In 1851 he was the standing American case for rank rising from nothing.
Read as Melville's defence of the book to come: tragic stature belongs to the man wielding a pick, so a whaleship's crew can carry the weight normally reserved for kings.
